newsitem.title: HUNGARY: OTP Sec. starts BorsodChem with "hold".
newsitem.headline: OTP Sec. starts BorsodChem with "hold".

text.p: Hungarian brokerage OTP Securities initiated a coverage on chemicals company BorsodChem Rt with a "hold" recommendation, saying that the stock's upward movements were limited in the near future.
"We believe that, for the short-term, share prices will not experience further increases," analyst Andras Szalkai said in a company report.
OTP Securities is a member of the OTP financial group.

"Any meaningful increase in price could be induced only by extraordinary factors, such as the announcement of a prospective acquisition," he said, adding that the target price should range between 5,900 and 6,600 forints.
On Thursday BorsodChem stocks finished at 6,580 forints on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
The analyst expected BorsodChem's profitability to increase steadily in the next few years, by 61 percent in 1997, 15 percent in 1998 and 17 percent in 1999.
"Much of this growth will be borne of the company's capacity expansion project - set to be concluded in 1997 - which is expected to substantially increase efficiencies," Szalkai said.
